subject: Film & Cinema
title: Sound Bridges: Connecting Scenes
description: One-minute skill: Sound Bridges: Connecting Scenes.

hook.text: A woman screams. Cut to a train whistle. Same pitch, different scene, seamless transition.

buildup.text: Sound bridges connect two scenes by letting audio from one bleed into the next.

discovery.text: This technique smooths hard cuts and creates subconscious emotional connections.

twist.text: Apocalypse Now opens with helicopter blades merging into a ceiling fan — an iconic sound bridge.

climax.text: Sound bridges are one of editing's most elegant tools and easiest to overlook.

punchline.text: The smoothest cuts are heard, not seen.

quiz.question: What is a sound bridge in film editing?
options: Audio from one scene bleeding into the next to connect them
